languageHint.title: Language hint
languageHint.description: Optional hint like en, hi, auto

keepLocalVideo.title: Keep local video
keepLocalVideo.description: If true, do not delete the downloaded file after processing

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry the Instagram download before giving up.

computeOutlierScore.title: Compute outlier score
computeOutlierScore.description: If true, fetch a sample of the account's recent reels online to build a views baseline and compute an outlier score (this reel's views / the account's median views). Best-effort: Instagram may rate-limit unauthenticated profile listings, in which case the score is null with a reason.

outlierSampleSize.title: Outlier baseline sample size
outlierSampleSize.description: How many of the account's recent reels to sample when building the outlier baseline. Larger is more stable but slower and more likely to be throttled by Instagram.

instagramCookiesJson.title: Instagram cookies (JSON)
instagramCookiesJson.description: JSON array of logged-in Instagram cookies. Strongly recommended: Instagram now usually returns an empty media response for logged-out requests, so a valid "sessionid" cookie is often required just to download a reel (and is needed to unlock view_count and channel_follower_count). Accepts a minimal list like [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}] or a full browser export (Cookie-Editor / EditThisCookie, including expirationDate). Re-export periodically — sessions expire.

instagramScraperActorId.title: Instagram Scraper actor ID
instagramScraperActorId.description: Apify actor used as the PRIMARY way to fetch the reel's direct video URL and metrics. Defaults to apify/instagram-scraper (RB9HEZitC8hIUXAha), which handles proxies, auth, and extractor upkeep for you. yt-dlp is only used as an automatic fallback if this returns no video.

ytdlpUpdateChannel.title: yt-dlp update channel
ytdlpUpdateChannel.description: Only used by the yt-dlp FALLBACK path (when the Instagram Scraper returns no video). Which yt-dlp build to self-update to before falling back: 'stable' is the latest tagged release; 'nightly'/'master' track bleeding-edge extractor fixes; 'none' skips the update and uses the binary baked into the image. Self-update is best-effort and never blocks a run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used for the Instagram download. Residential proxy is strongly recommended at scale to avoid being blocked.
